description: Referral routing to LOCAL sleep-medicine care — surfaces what KIND of facility to consult and (from a Council-ratified directory) which nearby facilities exist. Presentation only: NO appointment booking, NO telehealth scheduling, NO device sales (N6/N7, G4 referral-only). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 5 (suimin_referral_router).

recommendedFacilityKinds.description: Kind(s) of facility/specialist to consult — guidance, not a directive.

directoryEntries.description: Optional nearby facilities from the Council-ratified referral directory (REFERRAL_DIRECTORY_REGISTRY_CID). Presentation only.

urgency.description: G5: emergency for red-flag signals (routed via mitate emergency path).

area.description: Coarse area (e.g., 市区町村) — no precise patient geolocation stored.

publicContact.description: Publicly listed contact (phone/URL). No booking handled by suimin.

accreditation.description: e.g., 日本睡眠学会認定 検査施設, if applicable.
